messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — saw a regression in prod for INT4 path on H100L when seq_len > 1024. p95 latency jumped ~42% overnight :thinking_face:
Liam Chen: Ugh. Which model and which kernel picked? any changelist rolled recently?
Maya Patel: Model = rwd-llm-13b-v2, traffic ~20qps. Observed fallback swings between mm2_int4_v1 and mm2_int4_v2 during long responses. No recent deploys to serving runtime that I know of.
Sasha Ivanov: Could be KV warmup interaction — if kvcache miss pattern triggers a kernel switch we get workspace realloc + syncs. Did you see any OOMs or compile spikes?
Maya Patel: No OOMs. Perf traces show repeated kernel rebinds at token ~900..980. p50 stable, but p95 spikes.
perf-bot: Profiler output (sample):
```
time_window: 60s
kernel_samples_top3:
  mm2_int4_v1: 61.8% (avg 1.8ms)
  mm2_int4_v2: 33.9% (avg 1.2ms)
  kv_sync_overhead: 4.3% (avg 4.6ms)
seq_len_percentile: p50=410 p95=1438
```
Liam Chen: Interesting — mm2_int4_v1 dominates despite being slower on avg. Sounds like pick_policy hysteresis or safety margin is flipping under kvcache pressure. Can you paste the active pick config?
Maya Patel: Active pick snippet from runtime: 
```yaml
pick_policy:
  - arch: h100l
    quant: int4
    seq_bucket: <=1024
    kernel: mm2_int4_v1
    hysteresis_ms: 12
  - arch: h100l
    quant: int4
    seq_bucket: >1024
    kernel: mm2_int4_v2
    hysteresis_ms: 20
kv_warmup_behavior:
  prefetch_threshold: 8
  prefetch_stride: 256
```
Sasha Ivanov: Hysteresis_ms higher for >1024 — that could delay switching back to v2 during long streams if kvcache misses cause short bursts. Also prefetch_threshold 8 is low for longer sequences; we might see churn.
Liam Chen: Quick mitigation: lower hysteresis_ms for >1024 and bias pick_score towards mm2_int4_v2 when kvcache_ready==true. Patch suggestion: 
```diff
- hysteresis_ms: 20
+ hysteresis_ms: 6
+ pick_score_bias:
+  mm2_int4_v2: +0.08
```
Maya Patel: Can you run pickbench against a seq_len=1500 synthetic to validate? I can schedule a canary afterwards.
Liam Chen: On it — running pickbench now (pickbench flags: --seq 1500 --arch h100l --quant int4 --kvcache True). Will post numbers.
perf-bot: pickbench job queued: job_id pb-2025-09-05-42
Liam Chen: Results (baseline vs patched):
```
baseline: p50=1.75ms p95=4.95ms tail98=7.2ms
patched:  p50=1.18ms p95=3.12ms tail98=4.1ms
cpu overhead: +0.4%
notes: reduced kernel flips, kvcache hit stabilization
```
Maya Patel: Nice — big improvement at p95. Can we ship patch as a canary config to 5% on the dedicated fleet? Also want logs to verify no regression for short seqs.
Sasha Ivanov: I'll own the canary rollout and watch kvcache hit rates + kernel-switch traces. Will add an alert on kernel_flip_rate > 0.5/min.
deploy-bot: Canary config created: deploy/canaries/archcascade-int4-kv-warmstitch-20250905, scope: 5% h100l-dedicated, owner: Sasha Ivanov
Maya Patel: Thanks — once Sasha gives green, we can promote to full. Also adding follow-up item: run longer soak (6h) on mixed traffic to ensure no regressions for short seqs.
Liam Chen: I'll open a tiny PR to add the pick_score_bias and lower hysteresis, and include a unit test for pick stability under kv churn.
Sasha Ivanov: Sounds good. Will report back with canary metrics and trace snippets.
Maya Patel: Appreciated. :thumbsup:
